jp:
「やあ　桃太郎さん
　つづらの　中の　お宝を　取りに
　来たんですけど」{KP}
　
「どうやら　ハズレの　つづらも
　あるみたいですね～！」
en: "Hi, Momotaro-san. I came to get the treasure inside the wicker chests,"{KP}"but it looks like some of the chests are duds!"

"You're a persistent one, Momotaro! But fine!"{KP}"Just now, I got my hands on the body the God of Destruction will dwell in!"{KP}"I'll rough you up so you can't get in my way any more!"{KP}"Let's settle this!"

"You're a persistent one, Momotaro! But fine!"{KP}"Just now, I got my hands on the body the God of Destruction will dwell in!"{KP}"Now, I think I'll have you hand back that {bb}Red Bell{ww}!"{KP}"Let's settle this!"
